title: Free 10 Asia Miles Each Day at 2pm AEST (Limit 5,000 Redemptions Per Day) @ Cathay Pacific
body:
Deal: Free 10 Asia Miles Each Day at 2pm AEST (Limit 5,000 Redemptions Per Day) @ Cathay Pacific

[nightelves] Gets you 18 months of extension to your points.
[ozmaxz] Technically 10 mile will help to extend the points for another 18 months, am I correct?
[silverham] Out of stock today, wait (22hrs?) for next release.
[madreece] Did anyone get the points? How fast were you?
I've got 110K that need extending, now that Commbank has dropped them as a transfer partner.
[AsukaST] It's on the product page……
The e-voucher email serves as confirmation that your Daily check-in reward redemption has been successfully completed. Miles will be automatically credited to your account within three days.
[madreece] Thanks mate, I was wondering if anyone had any experience with how fast the 5000 redemptions lasted everyday, like seconds/minutes/unattainable?
[AsukaST] I clicked at 2pm Melbourne time, it put me in a virtual waiting room.
The queue was around 8 mins. After I login, I think I redeemed at 2:11pm.
Got a confirmation email 2 mins later.
[madreece] Okay sweet, I'll give it a try over the next couple of days. Thanks for posting it.
[nightelves] Yeah waiting for my points to credit as well.
